title: Bosch 18V Professional 4 Piece 2x5.0Ah Kit 0615a5008v $129 @ Bunnings Warehouse
body:
Deal: Bosch 18V Professional 4 Piece 2x5.0Ah Kit 0615a5008v $129 @ Bunnings Warehouse

[sammywammy] Seems all are coming up as unavailable :(
[furBug] Yeah looks like the stock evaporated in the time it took me to post the deal
[PopCounty] That comment really saved me from disappointment. Cheers.
[Rogue01] Can't find any links that work. Was hopeful. Cheers anyway
[Zuelly] I lied… Got to select a store with stock for C&C.
Some Melb Metro ones are OOS but went to one a bit further out and worked… thanks op!
[Zuelly] Their backend does update, frontend doesn't always display.. Can see another store (Mernda) which has some
And gone ;)
[garage sale] Taking delivery orders not sure what will happen to those as I doubt bunnings have central warehouse with stock, goes to stores
[pdtang] i had it in my cart, but couldn't get it delivered
[888Osella888] Boxhill and Oakleigh has stock for click and collect. Very tempting but I've already have 3 other brands and would like to stick to only one brand power tools
[CodeXD] I volunteer as tribute to take your other brand power tools 🤣
[888Osella888] 😂Hahaha… I barely use them actually. Will leave them alone for now.
[Irishness] problem is if they don;t take it off the shelf and put it away which often happens then someone comes in store & buys it & you lose out, I've learnt this the hard way
[capslock janitor] is it worth getting into bosch power ecosystem?
[3fornothing] With 6 yrs warranty and this price definitely
[3fornothing] Placed for the 4 piece, order confirmed, split into two orders
[sammywammy] How are people posting now ordering? I was on the 4 minutes after the post was made and the price is changed…
[sammywammy] I tried searching 0615a5008v but still not showing up…
[Zuelly] Bunnings I/N.
Deal is 0795676, I assume your seeing 0795678.
[sammywammy] @Zuelly: Damn! I just tried that now and they've changed the price I think
[piupiupiu] That is cheap even just for the batteries!
[Grover] Managed to snag one too - coming in multiple deliveries.
[sammywammy] If anyone has a link that still works for $129 could you plz post. Been needing a new drill for so long 😭
[Zuelly] https://www.bunnings.com.au/search/products?page=1&q=Bosch+1…
[tin tin] Crazy cheap, strange that all the stock is in VIC and also why all the links unavailable already.
[watts] nice. managed to get a delivery order in for 4pc kit + SDS drill skin + 2 x 8Ah batteries.
[stevco123] By the time they fulfil the click and collect, people that are already in store will buy them. Plenty of cancelles orders incoming. The perils of Ozbargain
[Grover] I think each of the products in the kit are available individually - the shipments are being split into multiple
[Schumi5] Could explain why when I ordered the 2 pack batteries got a notification that the order had been split.
[SoTightEcoLPI] That one went quick. Dropped the kids to school with 3 screens going to find stock. Called two bunnings with two phones via the link and both out of stock. One store I phone was looking solid, she said I have "11". I am can you physically find one for me. She said I've got 6 pallets of Bosch stuff here, I think it is for the Black Friday Deal.
[ozvictor] Order for delivery but highly doubt they have stock to fullfill it as they would be taken from people in store. Hopefully bunnings will offer sorry voucher.
[StingyShopper] no one is going to miss out on dinner tonight cos 1 bloke got 10 sets of drills.
If it was food or something life sustaining, then yeah sure get mad lol
[RichardF89] Innaloo WA shows 1 in stock but they don't have anything
[mapax] Damn, something I actually need and I was stuck talking to a member of the public.
[Zuelly] Still individual tools for $129 scattered around and can take gamble on delivery.
[Johnwick22] Mann missed out, really needed a hammer drill
[PVS7] My local store shows 6 in stock online but when I went there they said they don't have any and not sure why it's showing in stock.
[mapax] They’re all out the back so that staff can buy them…
[Zuelly] if you think bunnings staff are this organised or aware of deals, you are mistaken
ref: used to work at bunnings
